name: Kagari Konoka
source:
The younger sister of the main character. She knows the black history of her brother's existence.

She is a member of the construction company run by her father, and is completely at ease with the work site full of craftsmen.

She has a boyfriend who works as a trainer at a gym.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_182.html#character]official site[/url]]
